title: Evaluating Ensemble Methods for Algorithmic Stability Under Data Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2611.33375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard classification algorithms often exhibit sensitivity near decision boundaries, which can compound instability that already exists from overfitting to a subset of high-influence samples. Ensembling is commonly used to stabilize classifiers, but we show that it can destabilize those that are already stable. The well-established practice of subbagging can yield substantial improvements in stability, as we validate in the cause-of-death classification setting. However, its effect depends on the perturbation level, and for stable classifiers the finite number of bags introduces destabilizing Monte Carlo noise that shrinks only slowly as the number of bags grows. This instability can be mitigated, though, by the recently proposed inflated argmax, which allows for multi-class predictions in ambiguous cases. translated_title: 评估数据扰动下算法稳定性的集成方法
translated_abstract: 标准分类算法通常在决策边界附近表现出敏感性，这可能加剧因对高影响样本子集过拟合而已经存在的不稳定性。集成学习常被用于稳定分类器，但我们证明它反而可能破坏那些本已稳定的分类器。成熟有效的子装袋方法可以带来稳定性方面的显著改进，我们在死因分类场景中验证了这一点。然而，其效果取决于扰动水平，并且对于稳定的分类器而言，有限数量的装袋会引入破坏稳定性的蒙特卡洛噪声，且该噪声随着装袋数量的增长而缩减缓慢。不过，这种不稳定性可以通过最近提出的膨胀argmax（inflated argmax）方法来缓解，该方法允许在模糊情况下进行多类预测。我们进一步研究了Rashomon集——即实现接近最优预测性能的不同模型的集合——在多大程度上……
tldr: 本文揭示了集成方法对分类器稳定性的双面效应：子装袋可显著提升不稳定分类器的稳定性，但会破坏本已稳定的分类器，其有限装袋引入的蒙特卡洛噪声可通过膨胀argmax方法缓解。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that while subbagging substantially improves classifier stability under data perturbations, ensembling can destabilize already-stable classifiers due to slowly-shrinking Monte Carlo noise from finite bags, which can be mitigated by the inflated argmax method.
